priorityList: Use Rebuke to interrupt spellcasting as needed.
Cast Avenging Wrath (or Crusade) on cooldown, ensuring the target has the Expurgation DoT first if Holy Flames is talented.
Cast Execution Sentence immediately before Wake of Ashes if Avenging Wrath is active or you have the Radiant Glory talent.
Cast Wake of Ashes if Avenging Wrath is on cooldown (or you have Radiant Glory) and you are not at maximum Holy Power.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown, ideally synchronized with Avenging Wrath.
Use Holy Power spenders or Hammer of Light procs immediately if you are at 5 Holy Power or the Hammer of Light free proc is about to expire.
Cast Hammer of Light as your highest priority spender whenever available.
Cast Divine Storm as your primary Holy Power spender if there are 3 or more targets or if you have an Empyrean Power proc.
Cast Blade of Justice whenever Art of War or Righteous Cause procs.
Cast Hammer of Wrath on cooldown.
Cast Blade of Justice as a primary Holy Power generator.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and maintain debuffs.
Use Templar Strike, Templar Slash, or Crusader Strike as filler generators when other abilities are on cooldown.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities (like Fireblood or Light's Judgment) during Avenging Wrath windows.
